notes: The guns' fire by range (simcore/aaa.hpp): the fire control's errors (the aim across the line of sight, the measured velocity, the measured range), drawn once a pass; each round's own scatter; a time fuze's error. The rounds' calibre, velocity, rate, charge and self-destruct come from munitions.json. Calibrated in docs/DAMAGE.md against docs/research/AAA_DAMAGE_2026-11.md.
